summary: Warlocks are Shadow and Fire casters who summon demons, curse their enemies and drain life and mana from them. They use cloth armour and need Soul Shards for summons and conjured stones.
talent_levels_note: A talent ability can be taken once you can reach its row: the first talent point comes at level 10 and each row needs 5 more points, so row N opens at level 10 + 5 × (N − 1). Talent rows are from wowforevertalent.com; the Forever tooltips of Siphon Life (30), Shadowburn (20), Conflagrate (25), Wrack (40) and Incinerate (40) show the same levels.

abilities.name: Shadow Bolt
abilities.text: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing 12 to 16 Shadow damage.
abilities.summary: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing 12 to 16 Shadow damage.

abilities.name: Immolate
abilities.text: Burns the enemy for 11 Fire damage and then an additional 15 Fire damage over 15 sec.
abilities.summary: Burns the enemy for 11 Fire damage and then an additional 15 Fire damage over 15 sec.

abilities.name: Summon Imp
abilities.text: Summons an Imp under the command of the Warlock.
abilities.summary: Summons an Imp under the command of the Warlock.

abilities.name: Demon Skin
abilities.text: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 40 and increases health regeneration by 3 health per 5 sec. for 30 min.
abilities.summary: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 40 and increases health regeneration by 3 health per 5 sec.

abilities.name: Corruption
abilities.text: Corrupts the target, causing 40 Shadow damage over 12 sec.
abilities.summary: Corrupts the target, causing 40 Shadow damage over 12 sec.

abilities.name: Curse of Weakness
abilities.text: Physical damage caused by the target is reduced by 4 for 2 min. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.
abilities.summary: Physical damage caused by the target is reduced by 4 for 2 min.

abilities.name: Life Tap
abilities.text: Converts 30 + Spirit Health into 30 + Spirit Mana for you. Spirit increases the amount converted.
abilities.summary: Converts 30 + Spirit Health into 30 + Spirit Mana for you.

abilities.note: Curse of Agony in Classic. Banes are a separate category from Curses: one Bane and one Curse per Warlock can be on a target.
abilities.name: Bane of Agony
abilities.text: Afflicts the target with agony, causing 72 Shadow damage over 24 sec. This damage is dealt slowly at first, and builds up as the Bane reaches its full duration. Only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.
abilities.summary: Afflicts the target with agony, causing 72 Shadow damage over 24 sec.

abilities.name: Fear
abilities.text: Strikes fear in the enemy, causing it to run in fear for up to 10 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only 1 target can be feared at a time.
abilities.summary: Strikes fear in the enemy, causing it to run in fear for up to 10 sec.

abilities.name: Summon Voidwalker
abilities.text: Summons a Voidwalker under the command of the Warlock.
abilities.summary: Summons a Voidwalker under the command of the Warlock.

abilities.name: Create Healthstone
abilities.text:
Creates a Minor Healthstone that can be used to instantly restore 120 health.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.
abilities.summary: Creates a Minor Healthstone that can be used to instantly restore 120 health.

abilities.name: Drain Soul
abilities.text: Drains the soul of the target, causing 85 Shadow damage over 15 sec. Non-trivial targets damaged by Drain Soul have a chance to grant you a Soul Shard. Non-trivial targets killed by Drain Soul will always grant you a Soul shard. Soul Shards are required for other spells.
abilities.summary: Drains the soul of the target, causing 85 Shadow damage over 15 sec.

abilities.name: Health Funnel
abilities.text: Gives 12 health to the caster's pet every second for 10 sec as long as the caster channels. Generates reduced threat.
abilities.summary: Gives 12 health to the caster's pet every second for 10 sec as long as the caster channels.

abilities.name: Curse of Recklessness
abilities.text: Curses the target with recklessness, reducing the target's armor by 175 for 2 min. Cursed enemies will not flee and will ignore Fear and Horror effects. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.
abilities.summary: Curses the target with recklessness, reducing the target's armor by 175 for 2 min.

abilities.name: Drain Life
abilities.text: Transfers 10 health every 1 second from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec.
abilities.summary: Transfers 10 health every 1 second from the target to the caster.

abilities.name: Unending Breath
abilities.text: Allows the target to breathe underwater for 10 min.
abilities.summary: Allows the target to breathe underwater for 10 min.

abilities.name: Create Soulstone
abilities.text:
Creates a Minor Soulstone. The Soulstone can be used to store one target's soul. If the target dies while their soul is stored, they will be able to resurrect with 400 health and 700 mana.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.
abilities.summary: Creates a Minor Soulstone.

abilities.name: Searing Pain
abilities.text: Inflict searing pain on the enemy target, causing 24 to 29 Fire damage. Causes a high amount of threat.
abilities.summary: Inflict searing pain on the enemy target, causing 24 to 29 Fire damage.

abilities.name: Ritual of Summoning
abilities.text: Begins a ritual that summons the targeted group member. Requires the caster and 2 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must be out of combat and right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.
abilities.summary: Begins a ritual that summons the targeted group member.

abilities.name: Summon Succubus
abilities.text: Summons a Succubus under the command of the Warlock.
abilities.summary: Summons a Succubus under the command of the Warlock.

abilities.note: New in Forever: the Incubus is its own demon, learned at the same level as the Succubus.
abilities.name: Summon Incubus
abilities.text: Summons an Incubus under the command of the Warlock.
abilities.summary: Summons an Incubus under the command of the Warlock.

abilities.name: Demon Armor
abilities.text: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 210, Shadow resistance by 3 and increases health regeneration by 7 health per 5 sec. for 30 min.
abilities.summary: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 210, Shadow resistance by 3 and increases health regeneration by 7 health per 5 sec.

abilities.name: Rain of Fire
abilities.text: Calls down a fiery rain to burn enemies in the area of effect for 166 Fire damage over 8 sec.
abilities.summary: Calls down a fiery rain to burn enemies in the area of effect for 166 Fire damage over 8 sec.

abilities.name: Eye of Kilrogg
abilities.text: Summons an Eye of Kilrogg and binds your vision to it. The eye moves quickly but is very fragile.
abilities.summary: Summons an Eye of Kilrogg and binds your vision to it.

abilities.name: Drain Mana
abilities.text: Transfers 44 Mana every 1 sec from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec.
abilities.summary: Transfers 44 Mana every 1 sec from the target to the caster.

abilities.name: Sense Demons
abilities.text: Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap until cancelled. Only one type of tracking can be used at a time.
abilities.summary: Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap until cancelled.

abilities.name: Curse of Tongues
abilities.text: Forces the target to speak in Demonic, increasing the casting time of all spells by 50%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target. Lasts 30 sec.
abilities.summary: Forces the target to speak in Demonic, increasing the casting time of all spells by 50%.

abilities.note: Later ranks detect normal (level 38) and greater (level 50) invisibility.
abilities.name: Detect Invisibility
abilities.text: Allows the friendly target to detect lesser invisibility for 10 min.
abilities.summary: Allows the friendly target to detect lesser invisibility for 10 min.

abilities.name: Create Firestone
abilities.text:
Creates a Lesser Firestone which can be used to enchant your weapon with Fire, increasing your spell critical strike chance by 1% and the damage done by your Fire spells by up to 10.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.
abilities.summary: Creates a Lesser Firestone which can be used to enchant your weapon with Fire, increasing your spell critical strike chance by 1% and the damage done by your Fire spells by up to 10.

abilities.name: Banish
abilities.text: Banishes the enemy target, preventing all action but making it invulnerable for up to 20 sec. Only one target can be banished at a time. Only works on Demons and Elementals.
abilities.summary: Banishes the enemy target, preventing all action but making it invulnerable for up to 20 sec.

abilities.name: Hellfire
abilities.text: Ignites the area surrounding the caster, causing 86 Fire damage to himself and 86 Fire damage to all nearby enemies every 1 sec. Lasts 15 sec.
abilities.summary: Ignites the area surrounding the caster, causing 86 Fire damage to himself and 86 Fire damage to all nearby enemies every 1 sec.

abilities.name: Summon Felhunter
abilities.text: Summons a Felhunter under the command of the Warlock.
abilities.summary: Summons a Felhunter under the command of the Warlock.

abilities.name: Subjugate Demon
abilities.text: Subjugates the target demon, up to level 45, forcing it to do your bidding. While subjugated, the time between the demon's attacks is increased by 40% and its casting speed is slowed by 30%. Lasts up to 5 min. If you repeatedly subjugate the same demon, it will become more difficult to control with each attempt.
abilities.summary: Subjugates the target demon, up to level 45, forcing it to do your bidding.

abilities.note: Reworked in Forever: reduces all Magic resistances and raises Magic damage taken. Curse of Shadow is gone.
abilities.name: Curse of the Elements
abilities.text: Curses the target for 5 min, reducing Magic resistances by 45 and increasing Magic damage taken by 6%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.
abilities.summary: Curses the target for 5 min, reducing Magic resistances by 45 and increasing Magic damage taken by 6%.

abilities.name: Shadow Ward
abilities.text: Absorbs 290 shadow damage. Lasts 30 sec.
abilities.summary: Absorbs 290 shadow damage.

abilities.name: Create Spellstone
abilities.text:
Creates a Spellstone which can be used to enchant your weapon with Shadow, increasing your spell haste by 1% and the damage done by your Shadow spells by up to 14.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.
abilities.summary: Creates a Spellstone which can be used to enchant your weapon with Shadow, increasing your spell haste by 1% and the damage done by your Shadow spells by up to 14.

abilities.name: Howl of Terror
abilities.text: Howl, causing 5 enemies within 10 yds to flee in terror for 10 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.
abilities.summary: Howl, causing 5 enemies within 10 yds to flee in terror for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Summon Felsteed
abilities.text: Summons a Felsteed, which serves as a mount for the caster.
abilities.summary: Summons a Felsteed, which serves as a mount for the caster.

abilities.name: Death Coil
abilities.text: Causes the enemy target to run in horror for 3 sec and causes 285 Shadow damage. The caster gains 100% of the damage caused in health.
abilities.summary: Causes the enemy target to run in horror for 3 sec and causes 285 Shadow damage.

abilities.name: Soul Fire
abilities.text: Burn the enemy's soul, causing 344 to 430 Fire damage.
abilities.summary: Burn the enemy's soul, causing 344 to 430 Fire damage.

abilities.name: Inferno
abilities.text: Summons a meteor from the Twisting Nether, causing 200 Fire damage and stunning all enemy targets in the area for 2 sec. An Infernal rises from the crater, under the command of the caster for 5 min. Once control is lost, the Infernal must be Subjugated to maintain control. Can only be used outdoors.
abilities.summary: Summons a meteor from the Twisting Nether, causing 200 Fire damage and stunning all enemy targets in the area for 2 sec.

abilities.name: Bane of Doom
abilities.text: Afflicts the target with impending doom, causing 1742 Shadow damage after 1 min. If the target dies from this damage, there is a chance that a Doomguard will be summoned. Cannot be cast on players. Only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.
abilities.summary: Afflicts the target with impending doom, causing 1742 Shadow damage after 1 min.

abilities.name: Ritual of Doom
abilities.text: Begins a ritual that sacrifices a random participant to summon a doomguard. The doomguard must be immediately subjugated or it will attack the ritual participants. Requires the caster and 4 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.
abilities.summary: Begins a ritual that sacrifices a random participant to summon a doomguard.

abilities.name: Summon Dreadsteed
abilities.text: Summons a Dreadsteed, which serves as a mount for the caster.
abilities.summary: Summons a Dreadsteed, which serves as a mount for the caster.

abilities.name: Amplify Curse
abilities.text: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%. Lasts 30 sec.
abilities.summary: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%.

abilities.name: Curse of Exhaustion
abilities.text: Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.
abilities.summary: Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec.

abilities.name: Siphon Life
abilities.text: Transfers 11 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec.
abilities.summary: Transfers 11 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec.

abilities.name: Wrack
abilities.text: Tears the target apart from within for 6 sec, inflicting 60 Shadow damage every 1 sec. While channeling, your Siphon Life, Corruption, and Bane of Agony effects on the target deal their periodic damage 100% faster.
abilities.summary: Tears the target apart from within for 6 sec, inflicting 60 Shadow damage every 1 sec.

abilities.name: Demonic Sacrifice
abilities.text:
When activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 2 hrs. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned.

Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%.

Voidwalker: Restores 2% of your total Mana every 4 sec.

Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by 15%.

Felhunter: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec.
abilities.summary: When activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 2 hrs.

abilities.name: Fel Domination
abilities.text: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 6 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.
abilities.summary: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 6 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

abilities.name: Soul Link
abilities.text: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.
abilities.summary: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead.

abilities.name: Shadowburn
abilities.text: Instantly blasts the target for 65 to 74 Shadow damage. If a non-trivial target dies within 8 sec of being hit with Shadowburn, the caster gains a Soul Shard.
abilities.summary: Instantly blasts the target for 65 to 74 Shadow damage.

abilities.note: A talent in Forever as in Classic, but two rows higher. Later ranks are trained (up to rank 6 at level 60).
abilities.name: Conflagrate
abilities.text: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing 88 to 111 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect.
abilities.summary: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing 88 to 111 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect.

abilities.name: Bane of Havoc
abilities.text: Afflicts the target for 5 min, causing 15% of all damage done by the Warlock to other targets to also be dealt to the cursed target. Bane of Havoc is limited to 1 target, and only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.
abilities.summary: Afflicts the target for 5 min, causing 15% of all damage done by the Warlock to other targets to also be dealt to the cursed target.

abilities.note: Later ranks are trained (level 60 rank: spell 1293813).
abilities.name: Incinerate
abilities.text: Deals 100 to 114 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.
abilities.summary: Deals 100 to 114 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.

passive_talents.name: Demonic Pact
passive_talents.note: New capstone: your Demonic Sacrifice effect is no longer cancelled by summoning a different demon.
passive_talents.text: Your Demonic Sacrifice effect is no longer cancelled by summoning a different Demon pet. Resummoning the sacrificed pet will still cancel the effect.
passive_talents.summary: Your Demonic Sacrifice effect is no longer cancelled by summoning a different Demon pet.

changes: Curse of Agony and Curse of Doom are now Banes (Bane of Agony, Bane of Doom). A Warlock can keep one Bane and one Curse on the same target.
New talent abilities: Wrack (Affliction), Bane of Havoc and Incinerate (Destruction), and the passive Demonic Pact (Demonology).
Summon Incubus is a separate demon, learned at level 20 alongside the Succubus.
Enslave Demon is renamed Subjugate Demon.
Curse of the Elements now covers all Magic schools, and Curse of Shadow is gone.
Conflagrate moves to row 4 of Destruction (level 25).
conflicts: wowforevertalent.com says Curse of the Elements has a rank at level 20. Wowhead Forever only shows ranks at 30, 40 and 50, so the table uses 30.
Fan guides differ on whether Bane of Havoc is at row 5 (level 30) or is the 21-point talent. The table follows wowforevertalent.com (row 5).
gaps: Demon pet abilities (Firebolt, Sacrifice, Lash of Pain, Spell Lock and so on).
Every rank after the first and the level it is trained at.
Which spells are learned from quests rather than a trainer (in Classic: Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter, Dreadsteed).
Passive talents other than Demonic Pact.
